You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
G=load()

def get_cells(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg][0]
    comps=objs(I,bg)
    cells={}
    for comp in comps:
        for (r,c) in comp: cells.setdefault(r,[]).append(c)
    return bg,cells

# paint cases per demo object: top-row vs bottom-row behavior
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I=G[name+' input']; O=G[name+' output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg,cells=get_cells(I)
    print('==',name,'H,W=',H,W)
    for r in sorted(cells):
        cs=sorted(set(cells[r]))
        left=min(cs); right=max(cs)
        painted=[c for c in range(right+1,W) if O[r][c]==1 and I[r][c]!=1]
        # what was at end?
        end = I[r][right]
        print(f' row {r}: run [{left},{right}] len {right-left+1} fill {painted}')

import itertools
def feat_of(I, r, c, W, end, bg, t, b, eb):
    F={}
    F['d']=W-1-end; F['end']=end; F['touches']=end==W-1
    F['len']=c-end if False else None
    # run length ending at end
    L=1
    cc=end
    while cc-1>=0 and I[r][cc-1]!=bg: L+=1; cc-=1
    F['rlen']=L
    F['nruns']=[ ]
    cs=sorted([x for x in range(W) if I[r][x]!=bg])
    n=0; prev=None
    for x in cs:
        if prev is not None and x==prev+1: pass
        else: n+=1
        prev=x
    F['nruns']=n
    F['starts0']=cs[0]==0
    F['cpar']=c%2; F['endpar']=end%2
    F['above']=r>0 and I[r-1][c]!=bg
    F['below']=r<H-1 and I[r+1][c]!=bg
    F['left']=c>0 and I[r][c-1]!=bg
    return F

rows_data=[]
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I=G[nm+' input']; P=G[nm+' output']; H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for rr in I for x in rr); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                st=[(r,c)]; comp=set()
                while st:

                    comp.add((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and I[x][y]!=bg and (x,y) not in comp: st.append((x,y))
                seen|=comp; objs.append(sorted(comp))
    for o in objs:
        rs=sorted({rr for rr,_ in o})
        eb=max(c for rr,c in o); et=max(c for rr,c in o if rr==rs[0]) if len(rs)>1 else eb
        for rr in rs:
            fs=sorted(c for r,c in o if r==rr); end=max(fs)
            changed=[c for c in range(end+1,W) if I[rr][c]!=P[rr][c]]
            F=feat_of(I,rr,end,W,end,bg,rs[0],rs[-1],eb)
            F['changed']=set(changed)
            F['objsize']=len(o); F['nrows']=len(rs)
            rows_data.append((F,changed))
print(len(rows_data),'rows sampled')
# inspect a few feature vectors

def analyze(nm):
    A=G[nm+' input'];B=f(A);D=G[nm+' output']
    Hh=len(A);Ww=len(A[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r_ in A for v in r_); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[r for r in range(Hh) if any(v!=bg for v in A[r])]
    strips=[];cur=None
    for r in rows:
        if cur is None or r==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(r)
        else: strips.append(cur); cur=[r]
    if cur: strips.append(cur)
    info=[]
    for s in strips:
        runs_all={}
        for r in s:
            rr=runs_of_row(A[r],bg)
            runs_all[r]=[(v,len(v)) for v in rr]
        for r in s:
            for c in range(Ww):
                if A[r][c]==bg: continue
                if c>max(max(k for k,v in runs_all[r]) for r in s): continue
                if c<=max(c for c,v in enumerate(A[r]) if v!=bg)-1: continue
                # candidate fill cell to the right of some fg
                pass
        for r in s:
            er=max(c for c,v in enumerate(A[r]) if v!=bg)
            for c in range(er+1,Ww):
                Dv=D[r][c]
                feats=dict(r=r,c=c,strp=s,er=er,L=max((max(len(x) for x,_ in runs_all[rr]) for rr in s),default=0))
                # neighbor booleans
                up = r==0 or A[r-1][c]==bg
                dn = r==Hh-1 or A[r+1][c]==bg
                lf = c==0 or A[r][c-1]==bg
                rt = c==Ww-1 or A[r][c+1]==bg
                diag_uL=(r==0 or c==0) or A[r-1][c-1]==bg
                diag_uR=(r==0 or c==Ww-1) or A[r-1][c+1]==bg
                diag_dL=(r==Hh-1 or c==0) or A[r+1][c-1]==bg
                diag_dR=(r==Hh-1 or c==Ww-1) or A[r+1][c+1]==bg
                feats.update(up=up,dn=dn,lf=lf,rt=rt,dul=diag_uL,duR=diag_uRddl=diag_dL,duR=diag_uR,ddL=diag_dL,ddR=diag_dR)
                info.append(dict(feats=P,Dv=Dv,actual=D[r][c]))
    return info

import os,glob,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def solve(A):
    H=len(A); W=len(A[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r_ in A for v in r_)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg=[v for v in sorted(cnt,key=lambda x:-cnt[x]) if v!=bg and v!=1][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if A[r][c]==fg]
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    r0=min(rs); c0=min(cs)
    th=max(rs)-r0+1; twid=max(cs)-c0+1
    out=[r[:] for r in A]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if A[r][c]!=1 and (A[(r-r0)%th][(c-c0)%twid]==fg):
                out[r][c]=1
    return out
for i in range(1,9):
    nm=f'Demo pair {i}'
    A=G[nm+' input']; D=G[nm+' output']
    p=solve(A)
    mism=sum(1 for r in range(len(A)) for c in range(len(A[0])) if p[r][c]!=D[r][c])
    print(i,'bad',mism)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def solve(nm):
    A=G[nm+' input']; D=G[nm+' output']
    cnt=Counter(v for r_ in A for v in r_)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fgs=[v for v in sorted(cnt,key=lambda x:-cnt[x]) if v!=bg and v!=1]
    fg=fgs[0]
    H=len(A);W=len(A[0]);bs=bands_of(A,bg,fg)
    tmpl=max(bs,key=lambda b:sum(A[r][c]==fg for r in range(b[0],b[1]+1) for c in range(W)))
    res=[]
    for b in bs:
        if b==tmpl: continue
        r0,r1=b
        best=None;scand=10**9
        for dr in range(-H,H):
            for dc in range(-W,W):
                pred=set();ok=True
                for r in range(r0,r1+1):
                    for c in range(W):
                        rr,cc=r+dr,c-dc
                        if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W): continue
                        if A[rr][cc]==fg and A[r][c]!=fg: pred.add((r,c))
                        elif A[rr][cc]==fg and A[r][c]==fg: pass
                        elif A[rr][cc]==bg and A[r][c]==fg: ok=False
                if not ok: continue
                extra=sum(1 for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(W) if (r,c) in pred and D[r][c]!=1)
                miss=sum(1 for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(W) if D[r][c]==1 and (r,c) not in pred)
                sc=extra+miss
                if sc<scand: scand=sc;pred=pred;sh=(dr,dc)
        truefills={(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(W) if D[r][c]==1}
        tp=len(pred&truefills);fp=len(pred-truefills);fn=len(truefills-pred)
        res.append((b,sh,pred,tp,fp,fn))
    return res

for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:

# Hypothesis: each non-template band gets a shifted copy of template mask overlaid.
# Where template is fg and target was bg -> fill 1 (extra cells only). No erasing; existing fg stays.
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    A=G[nm+' input']; D=G[nm+' output']
    cnt=Counter(v for r_ in A for v in r_)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fgs=[v for v in sorted(cnt,key=lambda x:-cnt[x]) if v!=bg and v!=1]
    fg=fgs[0]
    H=len(A);W=len(A[0]);bs=bands_of(A,bg,fg)
    tmpl=max(bs,key=lambda b:sum(A[r][c]==fg for r in range(b[0],b[1]+1) for c in range(W)))
    trows=[r for r in range(H) if A[r][0]==fg and sum(1 for v in A[r] if v==fg)>len(A[0])*0.5]
    res={}
    for b in bs:
        if b==tmpl: continue
        r0,r1=b
        best=(-1,None,None)
        for dr in range(-H,H):
            for dc in range(-W,W):
                ov=sum(1 for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(W) if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W and A[r+dr][c+dc]==fg and A[r][c]==fg)
                if ov>best[0]: best=(ov,dr,dc)
        res[b]=best
    ok=True
    for b,(ov,dr,dc) in res.items():
        r0,r1=b
        m=[[A[r+dr][c+dc]==fg for c in range(W)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        out=[row[:] for row in A]
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(W):
                if m[r-r0][c] and A[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=1
        ok &= (out==D)
        print(nm,'shift',(dr,dc),'match',out==D)
    print('group ok',ok)

from collections import Counter
import numpy as np
def bands_of(D):
    cnt=Counter(v for r in D for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fs=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    f=fs[0] if len(fs)==1 else None
    nrow=len(D); m_=len(D[0])
    rows_fg=sorted(set(j for j in range(nrow) if any(D[j][c]==f for c in range(m_))))
    b=[];cur=[rows_fg[0]]
    for j in rows_fg[1:]:
        if j==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(j)
        else: b.append(cur); cur=[j]
    b.append(cur)
    return b,f,bg,nrow,m_

def score_pair(D,O,bi,ti,dr,dc,mode='paint'):
    F,BG,_=D[0],None,None
    bb,F,BG,nrow,m_=bands_of(D)
    sa=bb[bi]; tb=bb[ti]
    S=[(r,c) for r in sa for c in range(m_) if D[r][c]==F]
    Tr,Tc=min(tb),max(tb)
    tgtset={(r,c) for r in range(nrow) for c in range(m_) if O[r][c]==O[r][c]}
    Oarr=np.array(O); Darr=np.array(D)
    pred=np.array([[BG if False else 0]*0 for _ in range(0)]) 
    # simulate output: start copy of D on target rows
    Osim=[list(r) for r in D]
    for r,c in S:
        rr=r+dr; cc=c+dc
        if Tr<=rr<=Tc and 0<=cc<m_:
            if Osim[rr][cc]!=F: Osim[rr][cc]=F
    cost=sum(1 for r in range(nrow) for c in range(m_) if Osim[r][c]!=O[r][c])
    return cost

for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
    D=G[p+' input']; O=G[p+' output']
    bb,F,BG,nrow,m_=bands_of(D)
    best=[]
    for bi,sa in enumerate(bb):
        for ti,tb in enumerate(bb):
            if sa is tb: continue
            S=[(r,c) for r in sa for c in range(m_) if D[r][c]==F]
            Tr,Tc=min(tb),max(tb)
            for dr in range(-nrow-2,nrow+3):
                for dc in range(-m_-2,m_+3):
                    cost=score_pair(D,O,bi,ti,dr,dc)
                    best.append((cost,(bi,ti),dr,dc))
    best.sort()
    print(p,'best:',best[:3])

def stripe_rule(D,O):
    nrow,m_=len(D),len(D[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in D for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    F=[v for v in set(sum(D,[]))-{bg}]; F=F[0]
    # candidate rules: slope s in {-1,1}, period k, residue set S (size ~ nrow)
    best=[]
    for s in (-1,1):
        for k in range(2,nrow+1):
            # build target table from O
            tab={}
            conflict=False
            for r in range(nrow):
                for c in range(m_):
                    key=(c-s*r)%k
                    v=O[r][c]==F
                    if key in tab and tab[key]!=v: conflict=True;break
                    tab.setdefault(key,set()).add(v)
                if conflict:break
            if conflict:continue
            S=[v for v in tab.values()]
            if all(v==True for v in S.values()) or all(v==False for v in S.values()): continue
            pred=[[F if ((c-s*r)%k) in S else BG for c in range(m_)] for r in range(nrow)]
            bad=sum(pred[i][j]!=O[i][j] for i in range(nrow) for j in range(m_))
            # score: how well does it predict D too, penalize deviations from O
            best.append((bad,s,k,len(S)))
    return best[:5]

def solve(D):
    bg=Counter(v for r in D for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    n=len(D); m=len(D[0]); res=[]
    for r in D:
        rr=list(r)
        # candidate periods: try p from 1..m-1; require r[c]==r[c+p] for c in range(m-p) AND the prefix of r up to some point consistent
        best=None
        for p in range(1,m):
            ok=all(rr[c]==rr[c+p] for c in range(m-p))
            if not ok: continue
            # verify r is fully p-periodic on input; if so trivial, skip
            if all(rr[c]==rr[c%p] for c in range(m)): continue
            # alignment: find the longest run of bg-colored cells at end; extend from there
            # simplest: out[j]=rr[j] if j<m-p else rr[(j-(m-p)) % p]
            out=rr[:]
            for j in range(m-p,m):
                e=rr[(j-(m-p)) % p]
                if e!=rr[j]: out[j]=1
            best=(p,out); break
        res.append(best[1])
    return res

from collections import Counter
def solve(D):
    n=len(D); m=len(D[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in D for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[row[:] for row in D]
    # candidate vertical periods: smallest dr s.t. many rows match shifted copy
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if D[i][j]!=bg]
    best=None
    for dr in range(1,n):
        tot=sum(1 for i,j in pts if i-dr>=0)
        if not tot: continue
        good=sum(1 for i,j in pts if i-dr>=0 and D[i-dr][j]==D[i][j])
        score=good/tot
        if best is None or score>best[0]: best=(score,dr,good,tot)
    _,dr,_,_=best
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            if D[i][j]==bg:
                pred=False
                k=i+dr
                while k<n and D[k][j]==D[i][j]: pred=True;k+=dr
                if k>=n or D[k][j]!=D[i][j]:
                    pass
                # simpler: any non-bg cell at column j reachable upward with distance multiple of dr
                hit=False
                for kk in range(i+dr,n,dr):
                    if D[kk][j]==bg: continue
                    hit=True;break
                if hit: res[i][j]=1
    return res
for k in ['Demo pair %d'%i for i in range(1,9)]:
    D=G[k+' input']; O=G[k+' output']
    R=solve(D)
    mis=[(i,j,R[i][j],O[i][j]) for i in range(len(O)) for j in range(len(O[0])) if R[i][j]!=O[i][j]]
    print(k,'OK' if not mis else 'MISMATCH',mis[:5])
